index.title: Notifications
index.subtitle: What the system noticed while nobody was looking.

preferences.title: What you get told about
preferences.hint: Applies to you only, in this company. In-app and email are on unless you turn them off.

reverification_due.title: Carrier due for re-verification: {name}
reverification_due.body: {name} has no FMCSA check within the period your company set.

expiring.title: Document expiring: {title}
expiring.body: “{title}” expires on {date}. Upload a renewal before it lapses.

expired.title: Document expired: {title}
expired.body: “{title}” expired on {date}. Until a current version is uploaded and approved, it counts as missing.

overdue.title: Invoice overdue: {number}
overdue.body: Invoice {number} was due on {date} and still has a balance.

unattended.title: Lead waiting since {date}: {name}
unattended.body: {name} came in on {date} and nobody has taken it. The public page promises a reply within one business day.

assigned.title: A lead was assigned to you
assigned.body: {name} is now yours to follow up.

trial_ending.title: Your trial ends on {date}
trial_ending.body: After that the account moves to past due until billing is sorted out. Nothing is deleted.

trial_ended.title: Your trial ended on {date}
trial_ended.body: The account is now past due. Nothing has been deleted and nobody has been locked out.

link_not_sent.title: The customer never got tracking: {number}
link_not_sent.body: Load {number} was dispatched and the customer was not sent the tracking link. The public site promises they receive it when the load is dispatched.

declined.title: {signer} declined to sign {document}
declined.body: Reason given: «{reason}» — the load this document gates cannot move until it is resolved.

expired.title: Signature expired unsigned: {document}
expired.body: The link sent to {signer} expired on {date} and was never signed. They can no longer open it — send a new request.

rejected.title: {carrier} rejected the rate on load {load}
rejected.body: Reason given: «{reason}» — the load stands still until the rate is agreed.

changes_requested.title: {carrier} asked for changes to the rate on load {load}
changes_requested.body: What they asked for: «{reason}» — reissue the confirmation or call them.

unanswered.title: No answer to the rate on load {load}
unanswered.body: The confirmation sent to {carrier} on {date} has had no answer. Nothing has committed that rate, and the load is waiting.

tracking.link_not_sent: Tracking links that did not go out
